camel_example: aliyun polardb ModifyApplicationWhitelist --region cn-hangzhou --SecurityGroups 'sg-00000000000000' --SecurityIPList '127.0.0.1,172.17.0.0/24' --SecurityIPArrayName default --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --ComponentId 'pac-0000000000000000000' --ModifyMode Append
description_en: Modifies the IP address whitelist and security group configuration for a PolarDB application
description_zh: 用于修改PolarDB应用的IP白名单和安全组配置
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-application-whitelist --application-id pa-00000000000000 --component-id pac-0000000000000000000 --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1,172.17.0.0/24 --security-ip-array-name default --security-groups sg-00000000000000 --modify-mode Append --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyApplicationWhitelist

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application subcomponent. If you specify this parameter, the whitelist modification takes effect only for this subcomponent
parameters.help_zh: 应用子组件ID，若传入则白名单修改仅对该子组件生效
parameters.name: component_id

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses for the whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas
parameters.help_zh: 白名单地址，英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the IP address group. The default value is `default`
parameters.help_zh: 该IP地址组的名称，默认为`default`
parameters.name: security_ip_array_name

parameters.help_en: The list of security group IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID列表，使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: security_groups

parameters.help_en:
The method to modify the whitelist. Valid values:

Cover: Overwrites the original IP address whitelist. This is the default value.

Append: Appends IP addresses.

Delete: Deletes IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
白名单的修改方式，取值范围如下：
Cover：覆盖原IP白名单（默认值）。
Append：追加IP。
Delete：删除IP
parameters.name: modify_mode
